description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2221/19 of 29.03.2021, Moratuwa D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 520205
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land registration and title amendment under the Registration of Title Act. It specifies the registration of a particular parcel of land (No. 09 of Block 15) in Katubedda, establishes conditions for its use as a public park/playground, includes provisions about naming rights ("De Soyza Park"), and contains restrictions on alienation of the property. The content falls under the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land titles, property transfers, and land use conditions without involving government personnel changes or structural modifications.
